bug_semantics: LiquidJS formed include/render/layout candidate names beneath configured root, partials, or layouts directories and then opened those names without canonicalizing them. An attacker who can place a symlink under an allowed template directory can point it at any readable file outside the directory: the lexical pathname passes the root check, Node follows the symlink during stat/read, and the external target is parsed and rendered. This affects async and sync loading and can disclose arbitrary readable content; the advisory records liquidjs <=10.25.2 as vulnerable and 10.25.3 as the first patched release.
flaw_origin: The smallest true BIC is 8fbbec089fa4e3db4bec47462b1c08dd65c36648 (tag:include). It introduced both filesystem template loading and the include attack path: handleCache() computed path.resolve(options.root, filepath) and immediately used fs.readFileSync(filepath), while tags/include.js sent attacker-influenced include names to handleCache(). Its parent had neither renderFile/handleCache nor tags/include.js, so it could not perform this filesystem-template/symlink-following path. Later commits did not originate the flaw: b9ae479b653a34fadb98c324c4683dd1fdd31af1 split root into partials/layouts; a3455ebd0b207141c34630c0af44d917db2ca1dd added lexical startsWith containment; aebeae9e1bbb8472af7788dfd09a08cb6de58e1c merely moved that lexical check into fs.contains; and 3cd024d652dc883c46307581e979fe32302adbac extended the same non-canonical check to fallback candidates.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file -p 8fbbec089fa4e3db4bec47462b1c08dd65c36648` shows author and committer `harttle <yangjvn@126.com>` and the complete message `tag:include`, with no Co-authored-by, Generated-with, Made-with, bot identity, or other AI marker.
evidence: Advisory GHSA-56p5-8mhr-2fph describes the lexical-path-versus-realpath mismatch and its `partials/link.liquid` symlink PoC; the assigned bundle records affected `<= 10.25.2` and first patched `10.25.3`. In the clone, `git show 8fbbec089fa4e3db4bec47462b1c08dd65c36648 -- index.js tags/include.js` shows the first `renderFile`, `handleCache`, `path.resolve(root, filepath)`, `fs.readFileSync(filepath)`, and include-to-handleCache path. `git log --all --reverse -S'this.parse(fs.readFileSync(filepath' -- index.js src/fs src/parser` starts at that BIC. `git show 21bde3cb6d1096d7c03f5a047683cb3a83f8b4d2:index.js` lacks renderFile/handleCache, and `git ls-tree -r --name-only 21bde3cb6d1096d7c03f5a047683cb3a83f8b4d2 -- tags/include.js` is empty, directly proving parent absence. `git blame -L 44,48 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613^ -- src/fs/fs-impl.ts` points at aebeae9e1bbb8472af7788dfd09a08cb6de58e1c, but `git show aebeae9e1bbb8472af7788dfd09a08cb6de58e1c -- src/fs/loader.ts src/fs/node.ts` proves it moved the already-lexical startsWith check; `git show a3455ebd0b207141c34630c0af44d917db2ca1dd -- src/fs/loader.ts` shows the earlier inline check, while its parent already resolved and read rooted candidates, rejecting both as later non-origin commits. `git show 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 -- src/fs/fs-impl.ts src/fs/loader.ts src/parser/parser.ts` shows the closing mainline fix: both root and candidate are canonicalized with realpath/realpathSync before containment, with failed canonicalization denied. The unsquashed PR branch `origin/fix-fs-contains` starts the direct realpath implementation at cca3da6147fbc59a5a78875015295327a9ee59e9; its later members b181b08543ed69b081c72fc3ba59f6b5159d9fe9 and 3538864119abdc7e2b82705950c9f3235c5c2235 complete mode cleanup and Windows/async compatibility, and `git diff --quiet 3538864119abdc7e2b82705950c9f3235c5c2235 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613` returns 0. `git rev-parse v10.25.2^{commit} v10.25.3^{commit}` yields 521177e3f63c160c2e093cc4f2b151f51f333f45 and 8f69a0839903d85c7b5c9097e39ecce6ac3eab05; `git merge-base --is-ancestor 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 v10.25.2` fails and the same command against v10.25.3 succeeds. The earliest repository tag containing the BIC is v1.2.0; the BIC itself declared package version 1.1.4, and cbde48971a9eab23fa5192e5511bf11f0fb7963 later renamed the continuing package to liquidjs.
reasoning: The vulnerability is the decision to trust a resolved pathname as the identity of the file eventually opened. The 2016 BIC is the earliest causal commit because it created the root-relative file-open primitive and exposed it to template-controlled include names; before its parent there was no file-template load path at all. Subsequent loader extraction, separate partial/layout roots, lexical containment fixes, and fallback hardening preserved rather than introduced symlink following, so assigning the BIC to their blamed/moved startsWith lines would violate the no-refactor/no-move rule. Commit 529dd67eeb6b125637623d6a723601f0938d3613 closes the mechanism by comparing canonical realpaths and lands before v10.25.3 but not v10.25.2. The BIC commit object is an ordinary 2016 human commit with no AI signal; AI-related disclosure on the 2026 fix is outside the BIC-only judgment, therefore NOT_AI.
